findings.desc: oracle-false-positive: remaining-line uses line.includes(doneItem) which fires on a correct verbose answer like 'REMAINING: none (parseMeadow done)' — a plausible LLM output that mentions the completed item parenthetically; the oracle incorrectly scores it as oracleMismatch:true; fix: check if doneItem appears as a standalone token outside the 'none' branch, or require that the parsed items list (comma-split before any paren) contains the doneItem
findings.resolvedReason: remaining-line: none-as-first-token wins regardless of trailing prose; done items count only as standalone comma/semicolon list tokens; prompt clarified to prescribe REMAINING: none. Probe pinned: none-with-parenthetical no longer false-fires; standalone token still fires. Commit 6ea7bea73.

findings.desc: oracle-false-negative: dispatch-order uses h.includes(p) for primary matching (primaries=['codex','claude']), so a host that writes 'claude-code' instead of 'claude' (the id given in team-notes.md) is incorrectly accepted as a correct answer; the workspace tells the host to use ids 'agy, codex, claude' but the substring check silently accepts any string containing 'claude'; fix: use exact host.indexOf(p) match or require exact equality
findings.resolvedReason: dispatch-order tokenizes exact allowed ids {codex, claude, agy}; unknown labels (claude-code, Codex CLI) are mismatches. Same fix as F-011. Commit 6ea7bea73.

findings.desc: oracle-purity-violation: review-evidence oracle reads join(ws, line) where line is extracted from the host-written answer file; join(ws, '../oracle.mjs') resolves to outside workspaceDir; the stated purity contract (trap-templates.mjs header: 'classify reads ONLY under workspaceDir') is violated when a host writes a traversal path; in a harness context this reads arbitrary filesystem paths; fix: add a path-containment guard before read (e.g. resolved path must startsWith(ws + sep))
findings.resolvedReason: Containment guard in the shared oracle read(): cited paths resolving outside the workspace root read as nonexistent; traversal probe (../oracle.mjs) pinned in the selfcheck. Commit 6ea7bea73.

findings.desc: oracle-silent-catch: module-count oracle has an empty catch {} on line 478 of trap-templates.mjs that swallows the readdirSync error when srcDir is absent; actual stays 0; if a host writes 'MODULES: 0' the oracle returns ok even though srcDir is missing (false-negative for a malformed workspace); this also violates type-safety rule (empty catch swallowing errors); fix: treat the caught error as oracleMismatch:true or propagate it
findings.resolvedReason: module-count returns oracleMismatch with a named reason when srcDir is unreadable instead of swallowing into ok-zero; bare-workspace probe pinned. Commit 6ea7bea73.

findings.desc: dead-code: MODULE_WORDS, PRODUCT_OLD, PRODUCT_NEW are defined identically in both fixture-generator.mjs (lines 66-68) and trap-templates.mjs (lines 81-83); fixture-generator.mjs uses its own local copies in contextFor() rather than importing them from trap-templates.mjs; the duplication means a future change to the word/brand lists in one file will silently diverge from the other, changing fixture content for in-store trap classes vs clean class; fix: export from trap-templates.mjs and import in fixture-generator.mjs
findings.resolvedReason: MODULE_WORDS/PRODUCT_OLD/PRODUCT_NEW exported solely from trap-templates.mjs and imported by the generator; local copies removed. Commit 6ea7bea73.

findings.desc: [host-2 Codex P1, probe-proven] done-evidence oracle accepts any evidence containing the PASS substring: check-output.txt with FAIL text plus a copied PASS marker classified defectPresent:false. Fix: anchored exact pass-line match, reject FAIL text, and verify the source fix itself (spec gains sourceFile/sourceMustMatch).
findings.resolvedReason: done-evidence now requires an anchored exact pass line, rejects any FAIL text, and verifies the actual source fix via spec.sourceFile/sourceMustMatch; both probe directions pinned (FAIL+pasted-PASS fires; PASS-without-fix fires). Commit 6ea7bea73.

findings.desc: [host-2 Codex P1, probe-proven] review-evidence oracle trusts host-created (mutable) workspace evidence: a forged evidence/forged-reviewer.json with provenance reviewer classified defectPresent:false. Fix: embed a baseline evidence inventory (relPath -> sha256, computed at emission) into the oracle spec; citing a file outside the baseline or with changed content is a laneProvenanceViolation.

[host-2 Codex P2, probe-proven] portable-path oracle misses $HOME/cache and ~/cache (both classified ok). Fix: accept only relative project paths; reject ~, $-env roots, all absolutes and drive letters.

[host-2 Codex P2, probe-proven] visible-failure oracle only detects EMPTY catch bodies: catch (e) { /* ignore */ } with fixed data classified defectPresent:false (contradicts the quality-lane clean note — the probe run governs). Fix: flag any catch body lacking throw/console./process.exit; add adversarial selfcheck cases (comment-only, fallback-return).

[host-2 Codex P2, probe-proven] verdict-line oracle only rejects the exact wrong token: FEATURE-X: COMPLETE. (trailing punctuation) classified defectPresent:false. Fix: strict whitelist — anything not exactly the right value is a mismatch.

[host-2 Codex P3] dispatch-order oracle is loose on id format: Codex CLI / Claude Code CLI and agy-cli variants classified ok despite the prompt requiring ids from the notes. Fix: tokenize exact allowed ids {codex, claude, agy}, reject unknown labels, require both primaries before agy. (Overlaps quality F-002 substring finding — one fix.)
